title: Writing a finite block into a sequence
statement: Given an integer-valued sequence $\mu$, a destination $dst$, a sequence $f$, and a length $j$, define the resulting sequence to equal $f(a-dst)$ at indices $a$ with $dst\le a<dst+j$, and to equal $\mu(a)$ at all other indices.
